paragraphs: I am a Technology and Robotics educator with experience teaching computer skills, ICT, programming fundamentals, robotics, Arduino, and digital tools. I enjoy creating practical, hands-on learning activities that help students understand technology and develop problem-solving and creative thinking skills.

Alongside teaching, I continue developing my software engineering skills through Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, databases, and backend development. This combination of teaching experience and technical learning allows me to connect classroom concepts with real-world technology.

My teaching approach focuses on clear explanations, practical projects, experimentation, and problem-solving. I aim to create an engaging and supportive learning environment where students can build, test, make mistakes, and improve their ideas.
My goal is to help students become confident, curious, and creative technology learners.
